channel_details.description: Look up a channel's name, description, subscriber count, and view count.
channel_details.name: channel_details

parameters.description: The ID of the channel to look up.
parameters.name: channel_id

channel_id.description: YouTube channel ID (24-character string starting with 'UC')

related_playlists.description: Object containing special playlist IDs like 'uploads' (all channel videos). Use uploads playlist ID with youtube_playlist_items action

uploads.description: Playlist ID containing all uploads from this channel

subscriber_count.description: Number of subscribers to this channel. Use for popularity metrics or filtering

title.description: Channel name/title as displayed on YouTube

video_count.description: Total number of public videos uploaded by this channel

view_count.description: Total view count across all videos on this channel

channel_playlists.description: List playlists for a YouTube channel.
channel_playlists.name: channel_playlists

parameters.description: Channel ID to list playlists for
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.description: Maximum number of playlists to return
parameters.name: max_results

items.description: Array of playlists for the specified channel. Each playlist contains playlist_id (use with youtube_playlist_items), title, description, and item_count (video count)

item_count.description: Number of videos in this playlist

next_page_token.description: Pagination token for fetching the next page of playlists. Null if no more results

comment_threads.description: List the main comments on a video, not the replies.
comment_threads.name: comment_threads

parameters.description: The ID of the video to read comments from.
parameters.name: video_id

parameters.description: Maximum number of comments to return
parameters.name: max_results

items.description: Array of top-level comment threads for the video. Each thread contains comment_id, author name, text content, like_count, published_at timestamp, and reply_count. Use for sentiment analysis or displaying user feedback

comment_id.description: Top-level comment ID. This is the parent comment in the thread

like_count.description: Number of likes on this comment

reply_count.description: Number of replies to this comment

next_page_token.description: Pagination token for fetching the next page of comments. Null if no more results

most_popular.description: List the trending videos in a country.
most_popular.name: most_popular

parameters.description: Two-letter country code for the trending list, for example US or GB.
parameters.name: region_code

parameters.description: Maximum number of trending videos to return
parameters.name: max_results

items.description: Array of trending videos for the specified region. Each video contains video_id (use for details), title, channel info (id/title), view_count, and published_at timestamp. Use for discovering popular content

channel_id.description: Channel ID that uploaded this video

next_page_token.description: Pagination token for fetching the next page of trending videos. Null if no more results

playlist_items.description: List the videos in a YouTube playlist.
playlist_items.name: playlist_items

parameters.description: The ID of the playlist to list videos from.
parameters.name: playlist_id

parameters.description: Maximum number of videos to return
parameters.name: max_results

items.description: Array of videos in the playlist. Each item contains video_id (use for details/comments), title, description, channel_title, and position (order in playlist)

channel_title.description: Channel name that uploaded this video

position.description: Position of this video in the playlist (0-based index)

next_page_token.description: Pagination token for fetching the next page of playlist items. Null if no more results

search_videos.description: Search YouTube for videos that match your keywords.
search_videos.name: search_videos

parameters.description: Keywords to search for on YouTube.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Maximum number of videos to return
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.description: How to sort the results, for example by relevance or date.
parameters.name: order

items.description: Array of video search results. Each item contains video_id (use for details/comments), title, description snippet, channel info (id/title), and published_at timestamp. Use video_id with youtube_video_details for full metadata

channel_id.description: Channel ID that uploaded this video

channel_title.description: Channel name that uploaded this video

next_page_token.description: Pagination token for fetching the next page of results. Pass this as pageToken parameter to continue listing. Null if no more results

video_details.description: Look up a video's title, description, view count, likes, and length.
video_details.name: video_details

parameters.description: The ID of the YouTube video to look up.
parameters.name: video_id

comment_count.description: Total number of comments on the video

description.description: Full video description text (may contain links and formatting)

like_count.description: Number of likes on the video. Use for engagement metrics

title.description: Video title as displayed on YouTube

view_count.description: Total number of views this video has received. Use for popularity metrics or sorting

description: Search and explore videos, channels, playlists, and comments on YouTube.

youtube_new_comment_trigger.description: Runs for each new comment on a YouTube video, with its text and who wrote it. Replies to comments don't start it, and comments already there when the workflow is turned on don't either. It checks every 5 minutes, to stay within YouTube's daily limit.

output.author: The name of who wrote it.
output.url: A link that opens the video at this comment.

parameters.description: The video to watch: its link, or the part of it after watch?v=, for example dQw4w9WgXcQ.
parameters.name: video_id

youtube_new_playlist_item_trigger.description: Runs for each video added to a public YouTube playlist, with its title, description and link. Videos already in it when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every 10 minutes, to stay within YouTube's daily limit, and watches playlists of up to 500 videos.

output.added_at: When it was added to the playlist.
output.channel_id: The ID of the channel that uploaded it.
output.channel_title: The name of the channel that uploaded it.
output.playlist_item_id: This video's place in the playlist, as YouTube names it.
output.position: Where it is in the playlist, counting from 0.
output.title: The video's title.

parameters.description: The playlist to watch: its link (with list= in it) or its playlist ID, which usually starts PL.
parameters.name: playlist

youtube_new_search_result_trigger.description: Runs for each new public YouTube video that matches your search words, from any channel, with its title, description and link. Videos already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Each search uses a large share of YouTube's daily limit, so it checks once an hour.

output.channel_id: The ID of the channel that uploaded it.
output.channel_title: The name of the channel that uploaded it.
output.description: The start of the video's description.
output.live: upcoming or live for a live stream, otherwise none.
output.title: The video's title.

parameters.description: What to search YouTube for, as you would type it into YouTube's search box, such as "lodol tutorial".
parameters.name: query

youtube_new_video_trigger.description: Runs for each new public video on a YouTube channel, with its title, description and link. Videos already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every 5 minutes, to stay within YouTube's daily limit.

parameters.description: The channel to watch: its link (youtube.com/@name), its handle (@name) or its channel ID (starting UC).
parameters.name: channel
